searchText: Hi, We are an organization that actively develops applications on the Ethereum blockchain and extensively test our contracts and dApps on the Sepolia testnet. We’re looking for a way to acquire Sepolia ETH in bulk to support our ongoing development and testing efforts. Any assistance or guidance on this would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!
